pages.title: Color Block Pairs
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Color Block Pairs is a sliding puzzle about clearing matching blocks from a board. Drag a block along an available route until it touches another of the same color; the pair then disappears. Frozen pieces, linked blocks, and direction restrictions change which moves are possible.

There is no level timer, so you can plan around those constraints. Boosters provide help, and connecting pairs during an active combo raises your score multiplier.

pages.title: Slithoria
pages.creator: Goolandia
pages.description:
Slithoria puts a snake in an arena where glowing orbs make it grow. Gather the orbs, cut off rival snakes, and collect what they leave behind as you compete to become the largest survivor.

Move with the mouse and hold its left button to boost your speed. Completing challenges unlocks forty skins, giving you different appearances for the snake as you continue playing.

pages.title: Spring Magic Enchanted Wardrobe
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description:
Style a centaur princess and a fairy princess in Spring Magic Enchanted Wardrobe. Choose makeup, hairstyles, accessories, and spring clothing inspired by nature, creating a look for each heroine.

Use mouse clicks or touchscreen taps to make your selections. When the styling is finished, the game lets you save the result as a PNG image.

pages.title: Spin Thru
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description:
Spin Thru challenges you to orient a piece so it fits through an approaching hole. Tap to rotate it, swipe sideways to flip it, then swipe upward when you are ready to send it through.

A string of successful attempts activates Fever. During that temporary state, the game presents easier puzzles.

pages.title: Sweeper Curling
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description:
Sweeper Curling is an ice-curling game against the computer or a friend in two-player mode. Slide your stones toward the target and try to finish closest to its center to score. Sweeping helps control their speed along the ice.

Aim with the arrow keys, press Enter or OK to set the power, then press it repeatedly to sweep. Mouse and touch controls are also supported.

pages.title: Family Pet Dog Games
pages.creator: CodesXpirit
pages.description:
Family Pet Dog Games lets you play as a puppy helping a virtual family around the home and neighborhood. Assist the mother with a messy house, take part in household chores, and help neighbors during the dog's daily activities.

On a computer, WASD moves the puppy, Left Shift makes it sprint, and F performs actions. Touchscreen play uses a joystick.

pages.title: Bottle Logic
pages.creator: Hyper Rabbit Games
pages.description: Bottle Logic is a bottle-organizing puzzle with drag-and-drop controls. Move the bottles into their correct positions and work through arrangements that become harder as you progress. The game includes more than five hundred designed levels and an endless mode for continuing beyond the level-based challenges.

pages.title: 2048 Mayhem.io
pages.creator: Fo Technology
pages.description:
2048 Mayhem.io combines number merging with a growing snake-like tail. Collect cubes, join matching numbers, and pursue smaller rivals while keeping away from cubes whose leading number is larger than yours. The goal is to grow toward 2048 and climb the leaderboard.

Steer with the mouse and click to dash. Touchscreen controls use dragging for movement and a second finger to trigger the dash, which can help with chasing or escaping.

pages.title: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style is a dress-up game about preparing K-pop hunters for Valentine's Day. Choose outfits, apply makeup, and add accessories to create their holiday looks. Use the left mouse button or tap the screen to work through the styling choices.

pages.title: MergeDuel.io
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description:
MergeDuel.io is a real-time duel built around merging and upgrading cannons to summon fighting units. Drag cannons with the same number together, strengthen your forces, and respond to the opponent's units during the one-on-one battle.

Use the left mouse button for the interface and merging actions. The game includes rank progression and a leaderboard.

pages.title: Elementz
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description:
Elementz is a match-three puzzle where orb colors carry elemental powers. Swap neighboring orbs by dragging between them or clicking the space that separates them, then form lines containing at least three of one color.

Red represents fire, blue water, brown earth, green plants, and yellow electricity. Matches can trigger those different powers, adding elemental effects to the board's color-matching rules.

pages.title: Eat And Grow Fish
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description:
Eat And Grow Fish starts you with a small fish that must eat to grow while avoiding becoming another creature's meal. Work up through the food chain as you explore the game's underwater challenge.

Story Mode offers levels to play through, while Duel Mode lets two people compete. Use WASD, the arrow keys, or the mouse to control the game.

pages.title: Pixel Destroyer
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Pixel Destroyer is a physics puzzle about breaking every pixel block in a shape with bouncing balls. Drag to aim, then release the mouse button or your touch to fire a burst. Walls and obstacles let shots ricochet toward blocks that are difficult to reach directly.

Each level limits your attempts. Clear the entire shape before those moves run out, or the attempt ends in a loss.

pages.title: Math Wall Simulator
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Math Wall Simulator makes arithmetic the way through a series of barriers. Approach a wall, read its equation, and work out the answer to break through. Collect coins and unlock further challenges as you progress.

The game has twenty classes of increasing difficulty, beginning with basic calculations and moving toward more demanding math puzzles.

pages.title: K-Pop Puzzle Hunters
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description:
K-Pop Puzzle Hunters is a jigsaw collection with twelve pictures featuring Huntrix, the Saja Boys, and Derpy Tiger. Select an image and rebuild it from its pieces, using a hint when you need assistance.

Each picture can be played with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Mouse controls are available on a computer, with taps used for touchscreen play.

pages.title: Idle Baseball Tycoon
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description:
Idle Baseball Tycoon puts you in charge of developing a baseball franchise. Tap to earn, improve the stadium, and recruit players and coaches to strengthen the team's performance. Attracting more fans and selling tickets are part of growing the business.

Spend your earnings on the team and its facilities, unlocking features as the franchise develops.

pages.title: Papa Buzja
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Papa Buzja follows a journey to bring food, books, and supplies home to the children and build a house. Guide Papa through fields, forests, swamps, and mountains as he travels across the different terrain.

On a computer, hold the left mouse button and move it to direct him, with Space for jumping. A joystick provides movement on a touchscreen.

pages.title: Perfect Shot
pages.creator: Kankane Games
pages.description:
Perfect Shot is a pool puzzle in which one stroke must send every ball into a pocket. Drag to aim the cue and release to take the shot, planning around the positions and angles on the table.

Clearing all the balls opens the next challenge. Later levels change the layout and increase the difficulty of finishing the table with a single shot.

pages.title: Barry Prison Hide And Seek
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Barry Prison Hide And Seek gives you two sides of a prison hide-and-seek game. As an escapee, stay concealed and collect seals to take on the boss. As Barry the guard, search for every hidden escapee and stop their attempt to get away. Use mouse clicks or taps to play.

pages.title: Legend of Dragon Hunt
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description:
Legend of Dragon Hunt puts a skeleton hero against invading monsters and bosses. Steer with the joystick while the hero shoots automatically, gathering resources and new skills as you fight. Search the endless map for Dragon Crystals.

Player upgrades, pets, weapons, and a weapon-fusion system provide ways to develop the hero. The game also includes idle systems alongside the battles.

pages.title: ThumbPinball
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description: ThumbPinball is a physics-based pinball game about bouncing a ball toward particular targets. Work with the mechanisms and angles in each level to direct its movement, then take on the boss challenges as you progress through the game.

pages.title: Big Block Blast
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Place triangles and other blocks on the grid in Big Block Blast, aiming to form complete two-by-two squares. Drag shapes into place, matching colors when possible to earn bonus points as the blocks come together.

Some special blocks can sit on top of other pieces, giving you ways to work with occupied spaces. A block that fits anywhere and an option to swap the available blocks provide help when the current selection is difficult to place.

pages.title: Supermarket Shopping For Kids
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Supermarket Shopping For Kids combines shopping with running a checkout. Take the cashier's role and check out items, or try the additional mini-games available around the supermarket. Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with the shopping and store activities.

pages.title: Eco Block Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Eco Block Puzzle combines block puzzles with restoring a valley after an environmental catastrophe. Lead the ecologists as they clean up the environment, expand the restored land, and purchase animals and other lifeforms for the area.

pages.title: Ships 3D IO
pages.creator: Spinball
pages.description:
Ships 3D IO puts you aboard a multiplayer sailing ship in first person. Walk around as a sailor, operate the helm and sails, and use cannons against enemy ships. Sink opponents and shoot rival players to earn points.

Move with WASD and look around with the mouse. F interacts with ship equipment and items, clicking fires or swings a sword, and E or the number keys 1 and 2 change weapons.

pages.title: Cute Folding Paper
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Cute Folding Paper is an origami puzzle where the order of your folds determines whether a level is solved. Work through each paper-folding challenge step by step, choosing the sequence that produces the required result. Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with the paper.

pages.title: Majestic Dragons Merge
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description:
Build a growing collection of dragons in Majestic Dragons Merge. Spend coins on a chest, bring matching eggs together to hatch a baby, and continue combining dragons of the same age to discover new forms.

Mature dragons begin gathering coins over time. Their earnings feed back into buying more chests and developing the collection, connecting the merging puzzle with an idle income system. Tap and drag the eggs or dragons to make the combinations.

pages.title: Sea Match
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description:
Sea Match is a timed fish-tile puzzle. Click to swap tiles and make groups of at least three matching fish, using larger matches to increase your score.

Meet the level's target before time expires. Finishing quickly earns more stars, and special bonuses can help when you are stuck.

pages.title: Glacier Rush
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Glacier Rush is an endless driving game through a frozen landscape. Steer across snow-covered terrain among glaciers and icefields, keeping your vehicle moving through the wintry setting. The arrow keys control movement, and C switches the camera view.

pages.title: Dogs Spot The Differences
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Dogs Spot The Differences asks you to compare dog-themed scenes and find the details that do not match. Click or tap each difference with the mouse or touchpad. Finding the differences lets you unlock more levels, with later scenes bringing more demanding observation challenges.

pages.title: Coin Empire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Coin Empire ties empire building to a slot-machine resource system. Earn resources, spend gold on developing your base, and use attacks or looting to gain more from other settlements.

You can unlock heroes to support your conquests and advance through different ages as your territory grows. The building side gives you a place to invest the resources earned through spins and raids.

pages.title: Cat Girl Halloween Preparation
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Cat Girl Halloween Preparation is a seasonal styling game about getting Cat Girl ready for Halloween. Work on spooky decorations and a creative costume for the celebration, using the left mouse button to make your selections as you prepare her Halloween look.

pages.title: E30 Drift Simulator
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description:
E30 Drift Simulator puts an E30 car in a large city where drifting earns points. Use those points to develop a more customized version of the car while practicing slides around the streets.

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, look around with the mouse, and press C to switch cameras. T creates ramps that you can use for jumps, adding a stunt option to the city driving.

pages.title: Summer Match 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Summer Match 3 is a puzzle about moving summer-themed items between columns. Pick up an item and drop it onto another column, arranging at least three identical items in a horizontal or vertical line to remove them. Use the mouse to choose and move the pieces.

pages.title: Doc HoneyBerry Puppy Surgery
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description:
Doc HoneyBerry Puppy Surgery lets you care for injured and unwell baby animals as a veterinarian. Work through their care needs, treat injuries, and clean away the dirt before giving them a different look.

The game also includes dressing the animals in combinations of outfits. Use the mouse to interact with the treatment and clothing activities.

pages.title: Tower Match
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Tower Match challenges you to build a skyscraper by lining up each new floor with the one underneath. Precise placements earn coins, while an uneven landing cuts away part of the block and leaves a smaller surface for the next floor.

Keep stacking as the available space narrows. The aim is to build higher before the remaining blocks become too small to add another floor.

pages.title: Football Master
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Football Master is a physics puzzle where you shoot balls at an opponent through a scene filled with obstacles. Work out how to get a shot past the barriers and hit the target. Use the left mouse button to play, and replay a level when you want to improve its points total.

pages.title: Fill Pix
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Fill Pix is a coloring puzzle about reproducing a sample design. Click to fill individual pixels and color the shapes until they match the example. The challenge focuses on recognizing the arrangement and symmetry of the design as you decide which parts to fill.

pages.title: Domino
pages.creator: CHORSE GAMES LIMITED
pages.description:
Domino offers three ways to play a tile-matching board game. In Draw mode, match a tile from your pile to either exposed end of the layout. Block mode uses a similar arrangement, but a player who cannot make a move passes their turn.

All Five, also called Muggins, adds a scoring rule: you earn points when the pips at the board's ends total a multiple of five.

pages.title: Classic War Tankz
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Classic War Tankz is a color-matching shooting game. Check the tank's color, choose a ball of the same color, and fire it. Matching your shots to the tanks is how you build your score.

pages.title: Halloween Chibi Couple
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Halloween Chibi Couple lets you dress an anime-style girl and boy for Halloween. Choose costumes or dresses for the pair, then coordinate their makeup, hairstyles, and accessories.

The costume selection includes vampire, witch, ghost, cat-girl, and pumpkin themes. Use the mouse or touch input to try different combinations and put together the couple's holiday looks.

pages.title: Civilization
pages.creator: spaceFishing
pages.description:
Civilization follows a settlement's development from ancient life toward space travel. Collect the resources needed for the next era, make discoveries, and create mechanisms that improve how the community works.

Hire workers to gather resources more quickly as you prepare each advance. Control the game with the mouse, WASD, or the arrow keys, managing resource collection as your settlement moves into more advanced eras.

pages.title: Autocross Madness
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description:
Autocross Madness is a level-based driving game controlled through acceleration and slowing down. Hold the mouse button to gain speed and release it to slow the car, timing your movement along the course to avoid collisions.

Reach the route's end to complete the level. A progress bar shows how far along the course you have traveled.

pages.title: BFF Summer Vibes
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: BFF Summer Vibes is a dress-up game about giving a group of school friends summer wardrobes. Choose from dresses, tops, skirts, and accessories to put together their warm-weather looks. Use the left mouse button to select clothing and coordinate the items for each girl's outfit.

pages.title: What sound is this ?
pages.creator: BassoGames
pages.description: "What sound is this ?" is an animal-sound guessing game. Click to listen to a sound, then select the animal you think made it. The task is to recognize each animal from its call.

pages.title: Mahjong Alchemy
pages.creator: Little Missle
pages.description:
Mahjong Alchemy is a matching puzzle where you click identical cards to make pairs. Faster matches earn more points, so recognizing the next pair quickly helps your score.

Use the hint button at the side when you cannot find a match. Coins can also buy new cards, with rarer and more elaborate designs costing more. The Chinese-festival setting gives the matching game its visual theme.

pages.title: Sticky Road
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Sticky Road puts an older man in a wheelchair on a course filled with dangerous obstacles. Keep the chair balanced as you move along the route and try to survive to the end.

pages.title: Super Yacht Parking
pages.creator: Y8.com
pages.description:
Super Yacht Parking asks you to steer a yacht safely into its designated docking area. Avoid obstacles and other boats on the way in; repeated collisions end the game.

Use the arrow keys to control the yacht. Work through the levels, unlock achievements, and aim for a higher points total on the leaderboard as you complete the docking challenges.

pages.title: 1010 Golden Trophies
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
1010 Golden Trophies is a block-placement puzzle about collecting trophy pieces from a board. Choose block sets from the left panel and fit them into spaces, completing a full row or column that contains a trophy to collect it.

Play ends when no more block sets fit, so each placement also needs to leave room for what follows. Use the mouse or touchpad to arrange the pieces and complete lines containing the remaining trophies.

pages.title: Fortress Defense
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description:
Fortress Defense is a castle-defense game with five archers, fifteen enemy types, and one hundred levels. Protect the fortress from attacking creatures, earning gold after missions to improve both your archers and the castle in the shop.

Frozen, Poison, and Lightning bonuses provide extra tools against the attackers. Use the mouse or touchpad to play, choosing improvements and using the bonuses to support the defense.

pages.title: TriPeakz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: TriPeakz! is a solitaire puzzle with cards arranged in peaks. Work through the layout and clear all the peaks to win, using the mouse or touchscreen to select cards.

pages.title: Christmas Trucks Hidden Bells
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Christmas Trucks Hidden Bells is a timed search through truck pictures with ten hidden bells in each scene. Find every bell before the clock expires, working through eight levels.

Repeated clicks in the wrong area take an extra five seconds off your time. Click with the mouse or tap the screen when you spot a bell, aiming to finish the search without wasting time on inaccurate guesses.

pages.title: Blue Ball
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Blue Ball is a distance challenge where you guide a blue ball between tilted squares of different sizes. Move up and down to get through the gaps, avoiding contact with the obstacles spread across the screen.

Use the mouse or slide on the screen to adjust the ball's position. The goal is to travel as far as possible without hitting a square.

pages.title: Freecell Solitaire
pages.creator: ConteZero
pages.description:
Freecell Solitaire asks you to move the cards into four foundation piles, each running from ace to king in a single suit. Rearrange the tableau by placing a card on the next higher rank of the opposite color.

Top cards can also be moved into an empty cell or an empty tableau pile. Those extra spaces give you room to reorganize the layout while working toward the four completed suit sequences.

pages.title: Draw Attack
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Draw Attack links drawing with army strategy. Sketch or scribble your army, choose a battle, and use your soldiers to defend the homeland.

pages.title: Bounce Prediction
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Bounce Prediction is a puzzle about working out a ball's next bounce. Study the arrangement and the possible angles, then place your prediction where you expect the ball to go.

pages.title: X Parkour
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description:
X Parkour is a stickman runner built around getting farther through obstacle courses. Run, jump, slide, and adjust your movement to get past the challenges ahead.

Keyboard and gamepad controls provide forward movement, backward movement, jumping, and squatting. Use those actions to keep the stickman alive while trying to cover more ground.

pages.title: Halloween Mahjong Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Halloween Mahjong Deluxe is a tile-matching puzzle with thirty-six levels. Remove two identical Halloween tiles at a time, choosing only pieces that are uncovered and have at least one open side on the left or right.

Work toward clearing each layout and earning three stars. Use the mouse to select pairs, checking whether a tile is free before trying to match it.

pages.title: Mermaid Coloring Book
pages.creator: DressUpGames
pages.description: Mermaid Coloring Book is a painting activity featuring mermaid artwork. Use the mouse or touch controls to add colors to the picture and create your own color scheme for the scene.

pages.title: Numbers and Colors
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Numbers and Colors combines counting with color recognition in a balloon activity. Follow the color-and-number request and click the corresponding balloons, paying attention to both which color is needed and how many to select.

pages.title: Powerful Cars Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Powerful Cars Memory is a picture-pairing game with four levels. Flip the tiles, remember the pictures you uncover, and find matching pairs until the board is empty.

Try to finish using as few moves as possible. Click with the mouse or tap the squares to reveal them, using what you have already seen to help choose the next pair.

pages.title: BFF Princess Back To School
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: BFF Princess Back To School is a dress-up game about helping princesses prepare for their first day of classes. Choose hairstyles, outfits, and accessories from the available options to put together their school looks. Click with the mouse to work through the clothing and styling choices.

pages.title: Super Rocket Buddy
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Rocket Buddy is a physics puzzle where a cannon launches ragdoll Buddies toward a target. Find a route past the obstacles and keep trying with more Buddies until the shot reaches its goal. Play with the mouse or touch controls, solving each level's target challenge.

pages.title: Mine Cave Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Mine Cave Hidden Stars is a point-and-click search game where finding every concealed star lets you advance to the next level. Inspect each scene for stars that are difficult to see, then click or tap the ones you spot.

pages.title: Drive Your Car
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Drive Your Car puts a sports car on a single course that becomes harder as you continue. Avoid the other vehicles and try to keep driving for as long as possible. Each crash costs one life, with three lives available at the start.

Use the arrow keys to move the car and Space to make it jump, giving you another way to get past the traffic.

pages.title: Hidden Snowflakes in Plow Trucks
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Hidden Snowflakes in Plow Trucks is a picture-search game with six truck images. Find ten hidden snowflakes within one minute, examining the details of each scene before time runs out.

Use the mouse to select the snowflakes you discover. If you fail a level, you can restart it and search the picture again.

pages.title: Mountain Car Climb
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Mountain Car Climb is a 2D physics driving game about racing and climbing over mountains. Use the arrow keys to control the car as you take it through the mountainous terrain.

pages.title: Samurai Master Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description:
Samurai Master Match 3 asks you to arrange matching samurai-themed items in lines of at least three. Make combinations to raise your score while watching the meter on the left side of the screen.

The game ends if that meter falls too low. Use mouse clicks or taps to play and keep finding matching groups before the meter runs down.

pages.title: Knife vs Stack
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Knife vs Stack is an arcade game about breaking stacks with a knife. Work toward breaking them all while keeping the stack from hitting the side walls. Use the mouse to play and watch the stack's position as you act.

pages.title: Ball Wall
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Ball Wall challenges you to keep a bouncing ball in play with a moving platform. Position the platform beneath the ball to send it back into the playing area, preventing it from dropping out.

The ball gets faster as the game continues, leaving less time to position the platform for its next return.

pages.title: RS7 Sportback Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
RS7 Sportback Puzzle offers six car pictures to assemble as jigsaws. Choose an image, then place its pieces to rebuild the complete picture using the mouse.

Each picture has four layouts containing 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Select the piece count that gives you the size of puzzle you want to solve.

pages.title: Classic 2048 Puzzle
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Classic 2048 Puzzle is a number-merging game about combining numbers to produce larger values. Use the mouse to play and keep building bigger numbers through the available combinations.

pages.title: Royal Story
pages.creator: Diandian interactive
pages.description:
Royal Story is a fairy-tale management game built around making products and following character quests. Feed animals, supply machines with materials, collect what they produce, and craft items in workshops.

Biography Quests present character stories in chapters. You can also automate animal and machine production using operation points. Automation still needs the required ingredients, so keep the producers supplied if you want them to continue working.

pages.title: 10 Blocks
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description:
10 Blocks is a grid puzzle where you place supplied block shapes to complete horizontal rows or vertical columns. Filled lines disappear, opening room for more pieces.

Plan placements around the shapes still to fit. The game also provides a Gravity button that can be used once when you get stuck, giving you a limited extra option during the puzzle.

pages.title: Motor Hero Online!
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Motor Hero Online! sends a bike through a dangerous platform course with water below. Make jumps while escaping enemies and avoiding bullets and missiles, keeping the bike on its route.

Collect stars to unlock additional bikes and work toward beating the scores. Use mouse or touch controls to play through the motorcycle action.

pages.title: Tank Battle io Multiplayer
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Tank Battle io Multiplayer is an online tank arena game designed for battles between two to four players. Use the lobby's Play button to look for opponents, then try to destroy their tanks.

Your tank rotates automatically. Pressing the fire button makes it move straight forward and shoot at the same time, so the moment you press determines both your direction of travel and your attack.

pages.title: Casual Chess
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Casual Chess lets you play chess against a computer opponent as either white or black. Choose easy, moderate, or hard AI, then plan your moves against the selected difficulty.

A hint system can guide a move when you need help. Three visual themes also let you change the board's presentation while continuing the chess match.

pages.title: Teddy Bear Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Teddy Bear Puzzle is a jigsaw game with easy, medium, and hard settings for each picture. Choose a puzzle and fit its pieces together to reconstruct the teddy-bear image.

There is no time limit, so you can study the fragments at your own pace. Use the mouse or tap to play.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Passion
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Bubble Shooter Passion is a bubble-clearing puzzle where you fire colored bubbles into a grid. Aim shots to connect matching colors and remove their groups from the layout.

The game includes two modes and forty levels. Work through the bubble arrangements, choosing where to send each shot to build another matching chain.

pages.title: GTA Hidden Keys
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: GTA Hidden Keys is a hidden-object game about finding every concealed key to reach the next level. Search the scene for the missing objects without a time limit, working through it at your own pace.

pages.title: Black Fashion For Vogue Cover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Black Fashion For Vogue Cover asks you to prepare Bonnie and Emma for a cover photo shoot. Choose black outfits and accessories for both girls, putting together their looks around their shared favorite color. Use the mouse to make the fashion selections before the shoot.

pages.title: Zombies Vs Halloween
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Zombies Vs Halloween takes a zombie invasion to the Wild West. Use guns to protect the people under attack and keep your own character alive against the undead.

You can upgrade your guns, obtain equipment, and hire help as you prepare for the fighting.

pages.title: Fox Simulator
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description:
Fox Simulator lets you create a fox and explore an area containing forests, rivers, fields, and farms. Hunt animals, complete tasks, and develop your fox as you move through its surroundings.

You can also start a family and improve its members alongside your own character.

pages.title: High Heels Shoe Designer
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: High Heels Shoe Designer gives Kendall Jenner a shoe-design challenge before a party. Create a pair of shoes with your chosen colors and decorations, then select stockings that suit the finished design. Use the mouse to work through the styling choices and coordinate the shoes with their accompanying stockings.

pages.title: Stars & Royals BFFs: Kendall & Anna
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Stars & Royals BFFs: Kendall & Anna prepares Kendall Jenner and Princess Anna for an evening together. The friends plan to see a movie and chat afterward, and you choose their outfits and makeup for the outing. Put together a look for each of them before their cinema visit.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Easter
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle Easter offers sixteen Easter pictures to assemble. Rebuild the images from their separate pieces, working out how the fragments fit together to restore each seasonal scene.

pages.title: Jagged
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Jagged is a maze puzzle about reaching a solution quickly while eating all the candy. Tap and drag to move through the maze, working toward collecting the sweets and finishing the route as fast as you can.

pages.title: Valentines Day Mix Match Dating
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Valentines Day Mix Match Dating lets you arrange a different Valentine's outing for Moana, Anna, and Elsa. Help the princesses choose boyfriends for their exchanged dates, then select makeup and outfits for the occasion. Use mouse clicks to make the choices and prepare the three princesses for their plans.

pages.title: Hidden Objects The Mall
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Hidden Objects The Mall sends you through different mall outlets to recover missing items for their owners. Search the scenes for the objects that have disappeared and try to avoid mistakes, which damage your credibility as you work on the search.

pages.title: American Football Kicks
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: American Football Kicks is a timing challenge about directing football kicks into scoring areas. Press Space or tap the screen at the right moment to choose the kick's direction. Watch the indicator and time your selection to aim for the green area, which awards the highest score.

pages.title: Pregnant Fashion Show
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pregnant Fashion Show puts two pregnant princesses in a fashion competition. Help both contestants choose their outfits for the show, preparing the looks they will present as they compete to become the winner.

pages.title: ShapeMatcher
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: ShapeMatcher is a jewel-matching puzzle built around shapes. Use the mouse to select jewels and bring together at least three of the same shape. Look for larger combinations as you work through the matching challenge.

pages.title: Monsterfy Lady Gaga
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Monsterfy Lady Gaga asks you to give the singer a Monster High makeover for a concert. Help Frankie Stein choose a look inspired by Abbey, Catrine, or Skelita, then apply body paint, change the hair color, and add the chosen character's body mark with magical dust.

Finish the transformation by choosing clothes, heels, and accessories. Your selections take Gaga from the initial monster-inspired style to a complete outfit for her ghoul audience.

pages.title: Spider Soli
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Spider Soli is a card puzzle about building descending sequences in the tableau. Arrange cards into complete thirteen-card runs of one suit. Completed sequences go to the foundations. Discard all eight runs to win.

Click the stock to deal another row when you need more cards. Empty spaces can take any available card or an ordered sequence. The game offers one-suit, two-suit, and four-suit settings.

pages.title: Princesses BFFs Weekend
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princesses BFFs Weekend is a dress-up game about preparing friends for a warm-weather walk. Choose outfits for the princesses, then decide which place they will visit together. The activity combines styling their weekend looks with choosing the setting for their outing.

pages.title: Lovers Date Night
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description:
Lovers Date Night combines room decoration with styling a couple for a romantic evening. Arrange the table and choose details such as champagne, cake, or a meal to set up the date.

Then choose a dress and accessories for the girl and clothes for her boyfriend. Coordinate their outfits with the evening you have prepared for the pair.
